definitions.explanation: The degree to which something is wide or spacious.
The measurement of how wide something is.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦どのくらい→どのくらい：09584_donokurai⟧です⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
⟦{公園|こうえん}→公園：00581_kouen⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}いた→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧。
examples.english: I was surprised by how spacious the park was.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{感心|かんしん}→感心：02559_kanshin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: I am impressed by the breadth of his knowledge.

examples.japanese: ⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦ドーム→ドーム：24058_doomu⟧⟦{何個|なんこ}→何個：26687_nanko⟧⟦{分|ぶん}→分：03716_bun⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: How many Tokyo Domes would it take to equal the size?

examples.japanese: ⟦{道|みち}→道：00505_michi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{約|やく}→約：09563_yaku⟧10⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: The width of the road is about 10 meters.

examples.japanese: ⟦{視野|しや}→視野：08659_shiya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大切|たいせつ}→大切：01456_taisetsu⟧⟦だ→だ：09496_da⟧。
examples.english: Having a broad perspective is important.

notes:
{広|ひろ}さ is the noun form of the adjective ⟦{広|ひろ}い→広い：00704_hiroi⟧ (wide, spacious), created with the suffix ～さ.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- ～⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ (the size/extent of ~)
- {広|ひろ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧～⟦{平方|へいほう}→平方：27997_heihou⟧⟦メートル→メートル：02975_meetoru⟧ (~ square meters in area)
- {広|ひろ}さ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{驚|おどろ}く→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧ (to be surprised by the spaciousness)

MEASUREMENT USAGE:
When asking about room/area size in Japan:
- ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧？ (How big is this room?)
- {広|ひろ}さ⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧20⟦{畳|じょう}→畳：02224_tatami⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧ (It's 20 tatami mats in size)

FIGURATIVE USAGE:
{広|ひろ}さ can describe abstract breadth:
- ⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ (broadmindedness)
- ⟦{知識|ちしき}→知識：01463_chishiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{広|ひろ}さ (breadth of knowledge)

RELATED MEASUREMENTS:
- ⟦{面積|めんせき}→面積：05330_menseki⟧: Area (more technical/precise)
- ⟦{大|おお}きさ→大きさ：10969_ookisa⟧: Size (more general)
